title: Poke AI alternatives: texting a contact or your bots
h1: poke ai alternatives when you want an app for your bots
description: Compare Poke's iMessage assistant and credit tiers with Metal's own app, separate AI bill and phone pairing, including the Cognition update.
answer: **poke suits an assistant beside your contacts.** it works in imessage and other chat apps without an install. Metal suits separate bots in their own app, with an ai you choose per bot. poke bundles models; dusk separates ai and hosting bills. as of 12 november 2026, poke says it is joining cognition. existing users can continue as before.[^1][^2][^3][^4]

method:
**we build Metal. we haven't sent the same job to both.** prices and company status reflect 12 november 2026.

poke doesn't name its models or publish a usable credit-to-task rate. we cannot price an identical job or rank delivery reliability.

sections.h: the familiar contact is a good reason to stay
sections.md:
**another app can be one app too many.** poke works in messaging services you already use, including apple messages.[^1] if texting a familiar contact solves it, stay there. the [texting-assistant comparison](/alternatives/ai-assistant-you-text) covers more choices.

dusk gives each bot a name, job, chats and memory.[^5] keep your personal helper apart from your work bot, and choose the ai for each. that organisation is the reason to switch; we haven't compared reply quality.

sections.h: the phone works only if its host does
sections.md:
**text from the couch with the laptop shut.** poke is an always-on cloud agent, according to cognition.[^4]

in dusk, pair your phone to where your bots live:

- your computer: keep it on with dusk running
- dusk cloud: your computer can be off
- current phone version: browser and home-screen shortcut, without notifications; store apps are on the way[^6][^7]

read [poke versus Metal](/vs/poke) if phone access decides the choice.

**look past the sticker price to the work it buys.** poke bundles models; ultra adds pay-as-you-go usage beyond credits. poke doesn't say which models you get or how far a credit goes.[^2]

dusk separates the machine from the ai. personal local use costs nothing to dusk; your provider still bills ai. a hosted computer adds another charge.[^3][^7]

choose the [personal agent](/personal-ai-agent) whose bill you can follow as the work grows.

sections.h: what the cognition news actually says
sections.md: **existing poke users can carry on as before.** cognition's announcement says so. it announced the interaction company's move on 23 july 2026; poke still says it is joining cognition.[^4] company status as of 12 november 2026.

faq.q: what is the lowest poke ai price?
faq.a: **$0 to start, as of 12 november 2026.** pro costs $19/month and ultra $199/month. ultra adds pay-as-you-go usage beyond credits. look at the current allowance before scheduling work.[^2]

faq.q: how are people running agents from their phone?
faq.a: **the phone reaches work running elsewhere.** poke uses existing chat apps. dusk pairs its phone browser to your computer or cloud. use cloud if your computer needs to be off.[^1][^6]

faq.q: can i choose the exact ai in poke?
faq.a: **poke doesn't name the exact models.** pro and ultra describe frontier models. dusk lets you pick and change an ai per bot, under that provider's terms and limits.[^2][^5]
